description: Curtain panel length, the stock length to buy, rod width and total fabric width for a window. Style is how the curtain meets the floor: float, kiss, break or puddle. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

above.description: How far above the frame the rod goes, in inches. Default 6.

floor.description: Distance from the top of the window frame to the floor, in inches.

style.description: float (half an inch off the floor), kiss, break (1 to 2 inches extra) or puddle (3 to 6 inches extra). Default kiss.

width.description: Window width across the outside of the frame, in inches.

name: curtain_length
title: Curtain length calculator
